features.description: Phase 0: out-of-bounds set errors (D5), unsafeGet typed error, F32/F64 codecs exported from std/embedding, std/array header
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-bounds std/array.set is an error naming index and length
unsafeGet out of bounds is a typed error, not a Go panic
encodeF32LE/decodeF32LE/encodeF64LE/decodeF64LE exported and round-trip tested
make verify-stdlib re-frozen

features.description: Phase 1a: ArrayValue unboxed []float64 store behind accessors; all consumers migrated
acceptance_criteria: ArrayValue elements private; every consumer uses accessors
make/fromList/literals pack all-float non-empty arrays
show/==/toList identical across stores
Mutation check: Get reading only boxed store fails packed tests

features.description: Phase 1b: float kernels dot/axpy/scale/add/sub/mul/sum/argmax in std/array
acceptance_criteria: Kernels exported from std/array typed on Array[float]
Length mismatch and empty argmax are errors
Inputs not mutated; NaN behaviour tested

features.description: Phase 1c: VM TagArray + bridge (zero-copy float slices) + show/==; no-fallback tests; memory measurements
acceptance_criteria: std/array programs run via bytecode VM with no evaluator fallback
Mutation check: removing bridge case fails VM rows
10M Array[float] peak RSS < 200 MB measured
SGD benchmark ~0.1ms/step not regressed

features.description: Phase 2: updateMany and scatterAdd bulk updates
acceptance_criteria: updateMany one copy k writes, OOB error
scatterAdd length/OOB errors
100k batched writes to 3840-elem array < 50 ms
Binary decode builds packed store; bad length is Err
decodeFloatArray parses flat JSON number array without Json tree
1252x768 binary load < 50 ms and < 50 MB

features.description: Docs, prompt, example, changelog, design doc to implemented/
acceptance_criteria: examples/runnable/array_float_kernels.ail passes on both backends
Prompt rule for [float] vs Array[float], F32 marked lossy
stdlib.md row, CHANGELOG, design doc moved with measurements
